Planning Document 6

Clause 1: The flow of stormwater from developments needs to be managed so as to negate or reduce to an acceptable frequency the possibility of flooding buildings and/or the danger to life at any location, through the storage of stormwater where appropriate in developments and the control of major development drainage systems.

Clause 2: To protect the urban environment from the effects of otherwise uncontrolled surface stormwater flows resulting from infrequent (and lesser) storm events.

Clause 3: To minimise or negate disruption and/or danger to both pedestrian and vehicular traffic that may be caused by otherwise uncontrolled surface stormwater flows resulting from frequent storm events.
